summary: Points to win_environment as a basic PowerShell module example with check mode, diff and warnings, and win_uri as a more advanced one showing parameter types, choices, failures and exception handling; parameters are defined in an argument spec.
questions: Is there an example Windows module I can copy patterns from?
Which Windows module shows check mode and diff support?

answer_card.title: Example Windows modules
answer_card.answer_md:
- `win_environment`: basic example with check mode, diff support and warnings.
- `win_uri`: shows bool/str/int/list/dict/path types, choices, failing and exception handling.

Parameters are defined and validated by the `AnsibleModule` argument spec.
